subject: Mythology
title: AI and the Myth of Prometheus
description: A short lesson to help you apply AI and the Myth of Prometheus.

hook.text: Prometheus stole fire from the gods and gave it to humans. Now we are building AI and calling it fire.

buildup.text: Mary Shelley subtitled Frankenstein 'The Modern Prometheus.' Creating life always echoes the same mythological warning.

discovery.text: Tech leaders openly compare AI to Promethean fire — a gift that could enlighten humanity or burn it down.

twist.text: Zeus punished Prometheus by chaining him to a rock forever. We still have not decided what the cost of AI will be.

climax.text: Every generation faces a Prometheus moment: nuclear power, genetics, AI. The myth updates but the question stays.

punchline.text: We keep stealing fire. We keep wondering if the gods will punish us.

quiz.question: Why is the Prometheus myth relevant to AI development?
options: Because AI systems are literally powered by fire and electricity
Because creating powerful technology always echoes Prometheus's gift and its consequences
Because Greek mythology predicted artificial intelligence thousands of years ago
